Simulate a 1H-13C HSQC spectrum

Source: R/spectra.R
c13hsqc.Rd

Equivalent to `pybmrb.Spectra.c13hsqc()`. See [n15hsqc()] for parameter descriptions.

c13hsqc(
  bmrb_ids = NULL,
  input_file_names = NULL,
  auth_tag = FALSE,
  legend = NULL,
  draw_trace = FALSE,
  peak_list = NULL,
  output_format = "html",
  output_file = NULL,
  output_image_width = 800,
  output_image_height = 600,
  show_visualization = TRUE
)

Arguments

bmrb_ids

BMRB entry ID(s) — integer, character, or vector.

input_file_names

Path(s) to local NMR-STAR `.str` files.

auth_tag

Use `Auth_seq_ID` for sequence numbering.

legend

`NULL` (default), `"residue"`, or `"dataset"`.

draw_trace

Draw lines connecting same-residue peaks across datasets.

peak_list

Path to a 2-column CSV file of unassigned peaks (`H_ppm`, `N_ppm`) to overlay.

output_format

`"html"` (default), `"png"`, `"jpg"`, `"pdf"`, `"svg"`, or `"webp"`.

output_file

File path to save the visualization (optional).

output_image_width, output_image_height

Image dimensions in pixels.

show_visualization

Open in browser / display inline. Default `TRUE`.

Value

Invisibly, a list with the simulated peak list.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
c13hsqc(bmrb_ids = 15060, legend = "residue")
} # }
